text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Sonae is negotiating the possible purchase of a big retail chain in the north of Brazil, a company source told the paper.
- Private mobile phone company Telecel will launch a new mobile phone product, Vitamina T, next Monday.
- Thirty-eight soccer clubs are being investigated by authorities for possible tax evasion.
- The cabinet will approve measures to crack down on bureaucracy today. The paper learned that from now on it will be possible to set up a company in just eight days.

- Algerian state oil company Sonatrach considers expanding its presence in Portugal beyond natural gas and taking part in the partial privatisation of electricity group EDP-Electricidade de Portugal due next year.
